title: feat(spec)!: a navigation entry whose visible reads data must declare dataSource, refused at parse
body:
Fixes #24450

Clause-②: no (narrowing)

Question 2 of the ruling recorded on #24332 (comment 6259393328), letter A, verbatim as the director recorded it:

> **Question 2 — A.** A navigation item without a `dataSource` whose `visible` reads `data.*` is refused at parse, BREAKING with its ADR-0087 conversion, as its own `domain:spec` card, p1 `target:v18`, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`; in-repo impact measured at 0 declarations.

## What this does

- `packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts`: a module-private refinement, `navItemVisibleDataNeedsDataSource`, mounted once on `NavigationItemSchema` itself (a `superRefine` on the discriminated union). An entry with no `dataSource` whose `visible` is a CEL predicate that reads the root `data` gets one `custom` issue at its own `visible`. The message names the fix: declare `dataSource` on this entry, or drop the `data.*` read and gate on `current_user` or `features`. Because the check sits on the union, it reaches every navigation door: `app.navigation`, `app.areas[].navigation`, every `children` array at any depth, and a navigation contribution's `items`. The exported per-branch schemas do not chain it. That is the same posture as `objectNavTargetExclusivity`, and no runtime consumer parses a branch schema directly (measured with `git grep`: 0 non-test hits).
- The reader is `celReadsRootData`, a small CEL lexer in the same file (about 100 lines, no new export). It refuses only when it is sure. It skips strings (single, double, triple-quoted, and `r` / `b` prefixed) and `//` comments. It does not count member selection (`x.data`), a call named `data`, or a field or key name before `:` in a `{ ... }` literal. If a comprehension macro (`exists`, `all`, `map`, `filter`, `cel.bind`, ...) binds a variable named `data`, the reader returns "no read" for the whole predicate. A leading-dot absolute name (`.data.x`) and a `${...}`-wrapped predicate are read as root reads. It imports nothing from a runtime package (Prime Directive #2). The precedent for a predicate reader next to the schema that refuses on it is the settings manifest's `visible` grammar check in `system/settings-manifest.zod.ts`.
- The `visible` describe and TSDoc now say the read is refused without a `dataSource`. `content/docs/references/ui/app.mdx` was regenerated by `gen:docs`.
- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.nav-item-visible-data-needs-data-source.ts`: the D3 semantic entry (protocol 18). No key is removed, so there is no tombstone. There is no D2 conversion because the shape cannot be converted: only the author knows which endpoint the entry meant to read, and dropping the read would change what the gate means. The chart-binding narrowing (`view-chart-binding-dataset-required`) has the same shape.
- `packages/spec/dropped-refinements.baseline.json`: +31 sites, one `...lazy` site per published schema that carries `NavigationItemSchema`. The build printed the corrected entries and they are copied verbatim. `measured.droppedRefinementSites` goes from 781 to 812. JSON Schema cannot express a CEL lexer, so these are real new gaps of the projection, not of the rule.
- `.changeset/24450-nav-visible-data-needs-data-source.md`: `@objectstack/spec` `minor` with the **BREAKING** banner (pre mode), `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, one ADR-0087 marker (`registered nav-item-visible-data-needs-data-source`), and the FROM → TO mapping plus a one-line fix.

## Premise, measured on `origin/main` `26501ae24` before building

| PM assumption | Reading |
|:--|:--|
| An in-spec CEL root reader exists (`expression-scope-data-root.pin.test.ts`) | **Does not hold.** That file pins prose only (describe text) and reads no expression. No CEL identifier reader exists under `packages/spec/src`. The only predicate tokenizer in spec is the settings manifest's, and it is a different grammar (not CEL). So one was written, small and conservative, as described above. |
| Reach: 0 `data.` reads in navigation `visible` predicates | **Holds.** An AST census (TypeScript compiler API) of every tracked `.ts` / `.tsx` / `.mts` file at `26501ae24` counted object literals with an `id`, a navigation `type` and a `visible`. Result: 11 entries in 4 files. 2 read `data`, and both are in `app-nav-item-api-data-source.test.ts` and declare a `dataSource`. **0 read `data` without one.** Control leg: 3 of the same entries read `current_user`. The settings-manifest `visible` predicates (`service-settings/src/manifests/*`, 20 `${data.provider ...}` hits) are a different schema and were excluded from the census by path. JSON/YAML: 0 `"visible": "...data."` hits, against a control of 0 `"visible"` string values at all, so the JSON corpus has nothing to say here either way. objectui and cloud were not measured. |
| The refusal belongs at the entry's `visible` path | Holds. The path is `visible` relative to the entry, for example `navigation.0.children.0.visible`. |

## Tests (at `b911ad135b`, the head after merging `origin/main` `31ce45c07`)

- New `packages/spec/src/ui/app-nav-visible-data-needs-data-source.test.ts`, 23 tests. Refused, each with exactly one `custom` issue at `visible` and a message that names the fix: `data.total == 1`, `!data.has_more`, bare `data`, `has(data.total)`, a mix with `current_user`, `.data.total`, `${data.total == 1}`, `data['total']`, a read after a raw string ending in a backslash, the `{ dialect: 'cel', source }` envelope, the `dashboard` / `page` / `url` / `group` branches, and every door: `navigation`, a group's child whose parent declares a `dataSource` (the binding is not inherited), `areas[].navigation`, and a contribution's `items`. Accepted: the same entry with a `dataSource` (its `visible` envelope unchanged), `current_user`, `features`, both together, `current_user.data.total`, `data` inside a string, inside a triple-quoted string or inside a comment, a macro iteration variable named `data`, a selection on a call result, an entry with no `visible`, and a separator.
- Ablation, once, through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. Anchor `if (!celReadsRootData(visible.source)) return;`, count x1 → x0, blob `90cf1bbc` → `56f1eb19`. Result: **12 failed / 11 passed**. Every refusal case went red and every acceptance case stayed green, which is the expected direction. Restored: blob == HEAD (`90cf1bbc`) and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The test imports `./app.zod` from source, so there is no dist leg.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: 699 files passed, 21290 tests passed (1 todo).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test:repo`: 70 files, 1162 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: all 14 artifacts up to date after a rebuild of the merged tree.
- Consumers (accept-set narrowing, so downstream; these packages consume `@objectstack/spec`):
  - `@objectstack/lint`: full suite, 145 files, 6866 tests passed.
  - `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`: full suite, 246 files passed (3 skipped), 20655 tests passed.
  - `@objectstack/cli`: unit tier, NARROWED to the navigation and i18n files (`*nav*.test.ts`, `i18n-*.test.ts`). Of 35 named files, 27 are in the unit project: 27 files, 308 tests passed. The rest of the unit tier and the integration tier are declared to CI.
- Pin sweep: I searched the whole repo for the refusal text and for the old describe sentence ("has no `data` to read"). The only hits are the regenerated reference page. No test elsewhere pins the old acceptance.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on this diff derived 112 families. All 112 ran on `b911ad135b`, and `--ran` reconciles **112 of 112 run, 0 NOT MEASURED**, every one at exit 0. Six of them (`check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:doc-security-posture`, `check:skill-examples`, `check:docs-transcript-drift`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`) first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: no lint / formula / objectql dist). After a turbo build of the `@objectstack/lint...`, `@objectstack/objectql...`, `@objectstack/client...` and `@objectstack/formula...` closures (36 tasks, all cache hits), all six exited 0. The derivation warned that `origin/main` had moved 8 commits past the merge, touching `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `.github/workflows/spec-shape-gate.yml` and `scripts/ci/spec-shape-gate.mjs`. CI reads those from the merge ref.

## Acceptance notes

- **Not built, per the dispatch:** the page-element `visibleWhen` twin. A page component whose `visibleWhen` reads `data.*` with no API `dataSource` binding is the same shape. It is outside this ruling, which covers navigation entries only.
- The reader does not count `data` as a map-literal key (`{data: 1}`), which in CEL is an expression that reads `data`. That spelling is under-refused on purpose, because it cannot be told apart from a message field name without a type table.
- The metadata write door is reached through `METADATA_TYPE_SCHEMAS.app` = `AppSchema` (`packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-type-schemas.ts`). Its HTTP answer (`422 INVALID_METADATA`) is not measured here, and stored `sys_metadata` app rows are not measured either. The census found no such row in this repo.
- Labels: zero writes. The dispatch's write budget names no label.
